name: Brother Cormac the Annalist

intro.text: I keep the town's annals, like the Four Masters before me. This year's entry is blank. Let us give it something worth writing down.

win: Ink and quill! This goes in the annals: 'In this year a great battle on the Diamond, and the Annalist was well beaten, and was gracious about it, mostly.'
after: The Four Masters wrote 'a great wind this year' more times than I can count. In Donegal, that's just called a year.
